name: uv-python
postCreateCommand:
mkdir -p /root/.ssh && chmod 700 /root/.ssh && if [ -f "/root/.ssh/github-devcontainer" ]; then printf 'Host github.com
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile /root/.ssh/github-devcontainer
  IdentitiesOnly yes
' > /root/.ssh/config; chmod 600 /root/.ssh/config; fi && uv sync --locked --all-groups
